ip-list-type.description: source ip type: Trust or Black

redis-server-type.description: redis server type: CLUSTER mode or not

start-training-cnt.description: minimize sample count to start computing model <10, 1000>

schema-property.description:
Json schema properties used in
                    model training, which are defined in openapi v3.0

data-format.description:
data formats used in model
                    training. Here date-time, date and time are defined in
                    rfc3339, email is defined in rfc5322, hostname is defined
                    in rfc1034, ipv4 is defined in rfc2673 and ipv6 is defined
                    in rfc2373.

de-duplication-count.description: take the number of samples which have the same content as one valid sample(5-3600)

schema-required-ratio.description: the min percent of one key appeared in the sample pool as a required key(90-100 percent)

schema-ignored-ratio.description: the max percent of one key appeared in the sample pool as a ignored key(0-10 percent)

sample-limit-by-ip.description: collect sample limit for each ip source <0, 5000> per 30 minutes

svm-sensitivity-level.description: SVM Sensitivity Level, level 1 has minimum false positive and detection rate whereas level 4 has maximum false positive and detection rate

svm-model.description: SVM models used to do attack validation

parameters.description: Possible parameters to go in the body for the request

ip-list-type.description: source ip type: Trust or Black

redis-server-type.description: redis server type: CLUSTER mode or not

start-training-cnt.description: minimize sample count to start computing model <10, 1000>

schema-property.description:
Json schema properties used in
                    model training, which are defined in openapi v3.0

data-format.description:
data formats used in model
                    training. Here date-time, date and time are defined in
                    rfc3339, email is defined in rfc5322, hostname is defined
                    in rfc1034, ipv4 is defined in rfc2673 and ipv6 is defined
                    in rfc2373.

de-duplication-count.description: take the number of samples which have the same content as one valid sample(5-3600)

schema-required-ratio.description: the min percent of one key appeared in the sample pool as a required key(90-100 percent)

schema-ignored-ratio.description: the max percent of one key appeared in the sample pool as a ignored key(0-10 percent)

sample-limit-by-ip.description: collect sample limit for each ip source <0, 5000> per 30 minutes

svm-sensitivity-level.description: SVM Sensitivity Level, level 1 has minimum false positive and detection rate whereas level 4 has maximum false positive and detection rate

svm-model.description: SVM models used to do attack validation

vdom=* (All VDOMs)

vdom=root (Single VDOM)

vdom=* (All VDOMs)
